title: GeoHalt: Adaptive Token Halting for Efficient Visual Geometry Transformers
affiliations: Huawei Noah's Ark Lab · University of Waterloo
tldr: Learns, for every image patch, when it can stop updating. A drop-in module for VGGT, FastVGGT and SparseVGGT that runs **up to 2.16× faster** at 500 views while maintaining or improving reconstruction quality.
